verdict: Microsoft Store for Business integration failed. The Azure AD app registration for the MSfB connector has expired, been deleted, or lost its Graph permissions. Note: MSfB was retired in 2023.
fix: MSfB was retired. The only forward-compatible path is to migrate Microsoft Store app deployment to Intune + Winget or to MECM deployment types sourced from the vendor. For short-term continuity on a pre-retirement tenant: re-authorize the MSfB connector in `Administration -> Cloud Services -> Microsoft Store for Business`, refresh the Azure AD app registration secret, and confirm `Microsoft Graph` -> `Application.Read.All` is granted.
